However, full integration into the model_checker dispatch system requires deeper modifications to avoid breaking existing functionality. The modules are ready to be wired in when safe to do so.

1_symbolic_config.description: Symbolic config attribute handling for config.hidden_size patterns
functions: symbolic_config(field_names) - API to declare symbolic fields
resolve_config_attr() - resolve to symbolic or concrete
make_expression_symbolic() - convert config.X*3 to symbolic expr
propagate_chunk_shape() - compute chunk output shape with divisibility

3_reshape_minus_one.description: Reshape with -1 inference using Z3 divisibility constraints
functions: compute_numel() - compute element count (concrete or symbolic)
dims_compatible() - helper for symbolic dim checks
dim_equals() - helper for concrete vs symbolic
